answer: Perplexity-signature clustering resists sybils: the system measures the language-model perplexity profile of each identity's answers under a reference model and flags identities whose signatures cluster abnormally tight — the tell of one generator's fluency. A vine of genuinely independent agents scatters across perplexity space; a spiral of fakes from one model collapses to a narrow band. The jade-tight cluster is a fingerprint independent authorship does not produce, and flagged members route to a targeted re-grade.
